notes: County, cash basis, governmental funds only (no business-type funds). Trimmed page 1=report p5 (Statement of Net Position - Cash Basis), 2=p6 (Statement of Activities), 3=p7, 4=p8 (governmental funds receipts/disbursements/changes in fund balances), 5-11=pp30-36 General Fund budget schedule, 12-16=pp37-41 major fund budget schedules, 17-20=pp42-45 nonmajor budget schedule, 21-24=pp48-51 nonmajor combining schedules. Receipts and disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column on p4. The single 'Taxes' line (20,449,913) is split with the statement of activities general receipts on p2 (property 16,086,823, motor vehicle 1,464,375, lodging 313,821, inheritance 2,584,894). Public Works mapped to streets/highways; Public Assistance to health/welfare. Cash basis: beginning/ending cash are the net position/fund balance balances 21,950,972 and 18,108,660 (cash and CDs 12,395,321 + investments 5,713,339 at year end; beginning split not shown); ending_investments 5,713,339 is informational. Roll-forward: 21,950,972 + 30,982,641 - 34,178,313 + 4,492,115 - 4,492,115 - 646,640 = 18,108,660. Balance sheet is the cash-basis Statement of Net Position (no liabilities). Detail: General Fund budget schedule (departments, objects) recorded in full; zero/dash lines omitted. Objects mapped: Personal services = salaries and wages, Operating expenses = not itemized (generic bucket), Equipment rental = rent/leases, Capital outlay = equipment purchases (road capital outlay = construction/infrastructure; law enforcement center = land and buildings). Noxious Weed placed under natural resources/conservation, Surveyor under streets/highways. Transfers shown below the schedule totals are recorded as other financing outside printed totals. For nonmajor funds the combining schedule Total column (p22) is used (14 funds, more than 6) and the nonmajor budget schedule on pp17-20 is not recorded to avoid double counting; that schedule mixes transfers into receipts/disbursements (total receipts 2,719,955 and disbursements 3,159,708 include transfers 34,028 in and 122,807 out). The nonmajor combining schedules on pp23-24 are asset/fund balance schedules and are not recorded as detail. Read pages 1-24 of 24
